summary: CYGMA reports 1,438 people employed and paying taxes locally in 2019 and 4,320 in 2024. A 2025 report edition does not mean 2025 employment. Administrative coverage is broader than a pure games-publishing activity code.

search_log.outcome: General employment tables found; no separately verified comprehensive games workforce. CYGMA combines administrative sources.

series.label: People employed and paying taxes in Cyprus
series.industry_scope: Video game development/publishing company mapping; excludes iGaming as an intended scope. Administrative J58/J62 categories are imperfect proxies. Hardware, retail, venues and indirect jobs are not the intended total. Specialist services not separately quantified.
series.occupation_scope: All roles in covered businesses, including creative, technical and business functions.
series.geography_note: Source explicitly describes people employed and paying taxes in Cyprus. Citizenship and ownership not used as exclusions; offshore/remote treatment beyond this condition unknown.
series.worker_status: People employed and paying taxes; employee/founder/contractor/apprentice/intern split unknown.
series.contractor_treatment: Not separately specified; do not add contractor estimates.
series.method: Company and tax/statistical data assembled by CBusiness Advisors. Report identifies broad NACE classification and omitted-head-office issues.
series.comparison_note: Continuous 2019-2024 chart from one report vintage; domestic tax employment is explicit. Index is a within-series change only. Pure core scope and contractor coverage remain imperfect.
